title: Singapore Malaysia Bali Tour Package From Delhi
highlights: Experience the perfect blend of adventure and culture with this Singapore Malaysia Bali tour package from Delhi, exploring iconic attractions, scenic landscapes and rich traditions.
Discover the enchanting Night Safari Zoo in Singapore, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park, featuring over 900 animals in their naturalistic habitats.
Visit Batu Caves in Malaysia, featuring 272 steps leading to a sacred temple and the towering 42.7m-high Lord Murugan statue, the world’s second tallest Murugan sculpture.
Explore Kintamani in Bali, famous for its stunning views of Mount Batur, an active volcano rising 1,717 meters above sea level, providing a breathtaking landscape.
Immerse yourself in the charm of Ubud in Bali, known for its rich arts scene and scenic rice terraces, showcasing traditional Balinese culture and stunning natural beauty.
overview:
About the Destination:
Explore the wonders of Southeast Asia with our Singapore Malaysia Bali tour package from Delhi. Singapore, a blend of futuristic cityscapes and natural beauty, offers iconic attractions like Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa Island, and Marina Bay Sands while boasting lush green spaces and vibrant neighbourhoods such as Little India and Chinatown. Whereas, Malaysia is a cultural melting pot, with Kuala Lumpur’s soaring Petronas Towers, the spiritual Batu Caves, and the cooler climes of Genting Highlands. Bali is enchanted with its stunning rice terraces, serene beaches, and sacred temples, creating an exotic retreat surrounded by nature's beauty and rich traditions.

know_before_you_go: The activities and tickets included in the package are non-refundable in case of cancellation.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Please do not litter and keep the destinations clean.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Malaysia is a multicultural country. Kindly respect local customs, such as removing shoes before entering homes or places of worship.
This Singapore Malaysia Bali tour package is inclusive of visa assistance; however, the cost is not included in the package.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Singapore and Malaysia have a tropical climate with high humidity and frequent rainfall throughout the year. Pack accordingly with lightweight, breathable clothing and rain gear.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.
The currency used in Malaysia is the Malaysian Ringgit (MYR). It is advisable to exchange currency at authorised outlets or use ATMs.
It is recommended that you drink bottled water in Malaysia only to avoid potential health risks.
It is advisable to travel to Malaysia after being vaccinated for Hepatitis A, Tetanus and Typhoid.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance when booking Bali Singapore Malaysia tour package. Travel insurance is not included in this package.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Images are for representation purpose only.
All flight times are presented in Indian Standard Time (IST) for your convenience. Please ensure to check your local time zone for any adjustments.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Night Safari Zoo
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at Changi International Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel for check in. In the evening, get ready to go on a thrilling journey at the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park. Hop on the guided tram to observe fascinating creatures like civets and otters, and catch the captivating Creatures of the Night show (at an extra cost). Later, you’ll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Begin the day with a scenic cable car ride from Mount Faber Station to Sentosa Station. Upon reaching, start your adventure at S.E.A. Aquarium, where you'll witness over 100,000 marine animals, including sharks and manta rays. Next, visit Madame Tussauds, where you can pose with lifelike wax figures of global icons. Conclude the day with the spectacular Wings of Time show, a dazzling mix of water, lights, and fireworks set against the open sea. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Marina Bay Sands Observation Deck
days.desc: Start your Singapore sightseeing tour at Merlion Park, home to the iconic half-lion, half-fish statue symbolizing Singapore’s rich maritime history. Continue exploring attractions like the Civilian War Memorial and the Singapore Art Museum. Walk across the striking Helix Bridge, an architectural marvel, leading to Marina Bay Sands. From the SkyPark Observation Deck, perched 56 stories above, take in stunning views of the city skyline. Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kuala Lumpur | Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Kuala Lumpur. As you reach, get ready to explore the city with Istana Negara, the King’s Palace, featuring 22 majestic domes and beautiful gardens. Visit the grand Masjid Negara, Malaysia’s National Mosque, which holds 15,000 worshippers beneath its star-shaped roof. Finish the day at the Handicraft Centre, where you can admire exquisite local craftsmanship before checking in at your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Genting Highlands & Batu Caves Tour | Visit to Petronas Twin Towers
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to explore Genting Highlands, known for its lively casinos and exhilarating theme parks. Next, explore Batu Caves, where you’ll encounter 272 steps leading to a sacred temple and the impressive 42.7-meter-high Lord Murugan statue. In the evening, visit the Petronas Twin Towers and experience the Observation Deck, where you can walk across the world’s highest two-story bridge, taking in scenic views of Kuala Lumpur before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Sunway Lagoon Park
days.desc: Today, you’ll be driven to Sunway Lagoon Theme Park, boasting over 90 rides and attractions. Start your adventure at Sunway Surf Beach, one of the world’s largest man-made surf beaches, where you can enjoy thrilling waves at the Water Park. Visit the Wildlife Park, home to more than 140 species, including white lions and tigers. For an adrenaline rush, test your limits with bungee jumping or ziplining at the Extreme Park. After a fun-filled day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: On this day, check out of your hotel and get transferred to Kuala Lumpur International Airport for your flight to Bali. Upon arrival, board your transfer to the hotel in Kuta for check in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the place at your leisure. You can visit the Uluwatu Temple, a Hindu temple perched 70 meters above the ocean. Explore Padang Padang Beach, where you can indulge in water activities or stroll around the shore. Later. return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Kintamani with Bali Jungle Swing
days.desc: In the morning, you will be driven to Kintamani, famous for its stunning views of Mt. Batur, an active volcano. Take a stroll through the Tegallalang Rice Terraces that showcase traditional Balinese irrigation practices. Further, explore the serene Tegenungan Waterfall, surrounded by greenery and perfect for a refreshing dip. Later, experience the thrilling Bali Jungle Swing, soaring high above the lush valleys, before returning to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a sightseeing tour of Bali. Start your journey at the iconic Handara Gate, celebrated for its stunning backdrop of lush greenery. Visit the Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a beautiful Hindu Shaivite temple located on the shores of Lake Beratan. Continue to the scenic Pura Tanah Lot Temple, perched on a rock formation overlooking the sea. After a day filled with exploration, you'll be transferred back to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.
